systems.country_label: SIGE 2.0 (Sistema de Informação e Gestão da Educação)
systems.platform: SIGE 2.0, described as software built on the country's school administrative base
systems.owner: Ministry of National Education (DGEPASE), under the PESIDE project of the NGO FEC with European Union financing
systems.tiers: Practical training began on 6 October 2025 in four regions (Tombali, Quínara, Bafatá, Gabú); at DGEPASE five statistical technicians trained on the job to produce national and regional statistical bulletins on schools, pupils, teachers and results for 2014/2015 and 2020 to 2024

note: No fact: SIGE 2.0 is described as a platform for entering school data to produce statistical bulletins, with training at regional and central level; no entry by schools of per-learner records is described.
